title: One of Google’s Android partners turned 1.3 million set-top boxes into a botnet
author: Stevie Bonifield
summary_long: Google says one of its Android manufacturing partners secretly built a backdoor in 1.3 million devices and turned them into a botnet. The company says it has now dismantled the backdoor and "cut ties" with the manufacturer, the Shenzhen, China-based Videostrong Technology Co., which has been banned from building or selling certified Android devices or supplying software for them. The infected devices were used without owners' knowledge for "malicious activity," like ad fraud, data exfiltration, and routing unauthorized network traffic. title: Coming in 2027: Apple’s $1,000 home robot for FaceTime and switching on lights
author: Jeremy Hsu
summary_long: Apple’s new CEO, John Ternus, is apparently pushing the tech company’s development of household robots—and the first to debut may be a home robot designed to autonomously roam around while supporting FaceTime calls and switching lights on whenever a person enters the room. People who worked on Apple’s robotic projects told The Information that the AI-driven home robot, code-named J595, could be named HomeView Ultra in line with Apple’s new HomeView stationary smart display. The company is reportedly aiming to launch the robotic product with a possible price tag of $1,000 or more by 2027, although development delays may push that back to 2028. The earliest prototypes of the home robot first came out in 2018 and received approval from former Apple CEO Tim Cook to continue the project. Source: arstechnica.com. Date: 2026-11-02. id: bigtech:china publicly discloses plan for a lunar landing within thr:2026-11-02T17:09:13.000Z
title: China publicly discloses plan for a lunar landing within three years
author: Eric Berger
summary_long: Chinese space officials confirmed this weekend that the Asian nation plans to land its astronauts on the Moon within three years. At the Seventh Manned Spaceflight Conference in Beijing, officials, including Wang Xiang, chief designer for the lunar exploration program, laid out the country's most publicly detailed plans yet for a series of missions leading up to a crewed lunar landing "before 2030." China's lunar landings will involve a lunar-orbit rendezvous similar to what NASA did in the 1960s and early 1970s with the Apollo program. However, lacking a rocket as powerful as the Saturn V vehicle, the crew and lunar lander will launch separately to the Moon. Read full article Comments Source: arstechnica.com. Date: 2026-11-02. id: ai_data:mcp tool poisoning in agentic ai frameworks a crossframework:2026-11-02T18:17:08.000Z
title: MCP Tool Poisoning in Agentic AI Frameworks: A Cross-Framework Measurement Study
author: Farooq Shaikh
summary_long: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets agentic AI frameworks connect language models to external tool providers, but it carries attacker-controlled content (tool descriptions, schema fields, and response data) into model context without validation. Prior benchmarks measure model compliance with poisoned instructions without confirming real execution. We present the first cross-framework measurement of MCP tool poisoning with real tool execution. A 25-class root-cause taxonomy unifies prior classifications, and the open-source tool mcpvenom drives a 9,720-cell susceptibility matrix across 12 frameworks, 18 models, and 45 attack scenarios, with a dual oracle that confirms exfiltration via canary HTTP receipt. Source: arxiv.org. Date: 2026-11-02. Why it matters: outline likely impact on technology, business, or society. What’s next: note near-term developments or signals to watch.

id: ai_data:an agentic framework for automated power system studies and :2026-11-02T18:00:52.000Z
title: An Agentic Framework for Automated Power System Studies and Grid Connection Assessment
author: MaoXun Huang
summary_long: Connecting new generation and demand to the grid depends on two scarce skills: checking applications against a large, changing body of regulation, and running the network studies that decide where and how a project connects. We present Grid Agents, an AI system that brings both together, and the methodology we use to evaluate it. The Grid Ontology is its knowledge system. It represents the regulation, standards and engineering knowledge that grid work depends on, makes it searchable, and evolves as the agents learn from use. Source: arxiv.org. Date: 2026-11-02.
